name: Koliwar
reviewOutcome: Official Bihar cadastral custodian and public viewer are evidenced, but anonymous parcel-vector integration is unqualified.
custodianAssessment: Bihar Government’s Revenue and Land Reforms Department and its Directorate of Land Records & Survey are the evidenced custodians. BhuNaksha Bihar is a public cadastral map viewer, while national/general mapping references were not used as local registry evidence.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries found the official Bihar Bhumi gateway and BhuNaksha viewer. The viewer exposed Bhojpur–Ara Sadar–Koilwar–कोईलवर and survey choices RS/CS.
requestOutcomes: The current landing/viewer HTML, ScalarDatahandler hierarchy, and extent REST route were retrieved. The extent response reported EPSG:32645 and gisCode RS29010201651320701. The exact WUP point transformed to [274603.1649538847, 2829246.275738771], outside the returned extent; point lookup was empty. A bounded plot lookup and WMS GetCapabilities attempt did not yield a usable vector parcel record.
endpointInspection: Viewer JavaScript showed REST routes getVVVVExtentGeoref, getPlotAtXY, ScalarDatahandler, and WMS. The map layer is WMS-rendered; no public vector schema or geometry-bearing anonymous response was verified.

geometryEvidence.reason: No unchanged native parcel geometry response was received.

scopeLimits: The exact-point miss and sheet extent miss are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
One selected sheet does not establish citywide polygon completeness, administrative boundary alignment, or coverage across other sheets/mauzas.
WMS display evidence is not retained parcel-vector geometry and does not establish a stable native parcel identity for runtime use.
No source integration, adapter qualification, or admission is claimed.
uncertainty: Moderate for existence of an official Bihar/Koilwar cadastral map service; high for anonymous vector geometry availability, citywide coverage, and parcel identity behavior.
recommendedDisposition: Hold for serial reviewer retry with independent sheet discovery and adapter qualification.
